title: Arching Pinnate-Crown Desert Palm
description: One original static pinnate-crown desert palm. A gently bent tapering trunk has integral shallow ring-scar bands and a compact swollen terminal crown. Eight unequal long arching fronds spread and droop from the crown; each has a whole curved rachis with fourteen separate narrow folded pinnae and a terminal blade. The open gaps run along the full leaf axes rather than forming the radial clefts of a fused fan palm. All numeric trunk and leaf paths are newly authored; no old fern, palm mesh or external plant is imported or scaled. One complete tree, not a color, leaf-count or size variant. Static stylized vegetation only, no species-accuracy, fruit, growth, wind animation, rooting mechanics or stability claim.
